Close recreations of a familiar block-building game (Minecraft 1.21.4, Lucky Block World, 1.8 KIT PVP) reach Up-and-Coming and Top Trending within their first month but hold mid-to-low positions
new.rationale: Today three such games were profiled at once: Minecraft 1.21.4 (21 days, Up-and-Coming #88, 5.6M visits), Lucky Block World (26 days, Up-and-Coming #91) and 1.8 KIT PVP (32 days, Top Trending #97). All sit near the bottom of their chart. Confirm if more enter and stay below #60 for two weeks; refute if one climbs into the top 30 or they all fall off within a week. Name recognition and IP risk are likely confounders.

qualitative_updates.note: In the first full November week several Halloween-tagged games left charts on the same day: Dead Rails [EVENT] left Most Popular; Infectious Smile [HALLOWEEN], Roll a Barber RNG and Elemental Dungeons left Top Earning; Ink Game and The Mimic left Top Trending. Games that shipped a follow-up (Anime Dimensions' Nov 2 update) held their place.

Monster Maker (+42, 14 days) and Survive Your Ideas (+41, 30 days) were the second- and third-biggest Up-and-Coming risers today, but Make a Cartoon! left both Up-and-Coming and Top Trending. Evidence is mixed, so confidence goes up only a little.
DONT SPLASH (19 days) is again among the best on both Most Popular and Up-and-Coming; MOUSE entered Most Popular but left Up-and-Coming on the same day.
